artifacts.summary: 10-phase, 16-hour plan: two new leaf modules (Semantics/ValidityLayer.lean with class PointTruth and the Generic* validity layer; Semantics/TruthClauses.lean with Env-parameterised operator/clause classes and generic derived-clause lemmas), instantiated one language per phase by replacing 38 validity-layer and 37 (+2) clause-layer proof bodies with delegations, every name/statement/attribute preserved, per-phase axiom-parity gate, extension contract written last from the instantiations performed.

memory_candidates.content: Statement-preserving abstraction in this repo: when writing a generic class-polymorphic layer whose per-language names must stay byte-identical, keep the existing defs as `def` (never promote to `abbrev`), replace only theorem proof bodies with one-line delegations (named args `(L := X) (φ := φ)` fix instance-metavariable elaboration), capture `#print axioms` for every wrapper BEFORE editing and diff after each phase (generic proofs must avoid `by_contra`/`push_neg` where the original was `rw`+terms or `[propext]`-only baselines drift). Naming constraint from check-module-invariants.sh C23: a bare declaration name must not be reused in a namespace nested under one that already declares it bare (e.g. `PointTruth.ValidIn` under `FormalSystem.Semantics` collides with L's bare `ValidIn`); use the tree's language-prefix convention (`GenericValidIn`) or a sibling namespace, never dot-qualified evasion. A generic module below `Truth.lean` cannot name `SameStateAt` (defined in PlusTruth.lean): carry such relations as class fields.
